title: A separable polynomial quotient over an algebraically closed field is a product of copies of the field
statement: Let $F$ be a field [def-weil-field], let $P\in F[T]$ be monic and separable [def-pc-separable-polynomial] of degree $n$, and let $\Omega$ be an algebraically closed field containing $F$ [def-weil-algebraic-closure]. Write $R=\Omega[T]/(P)$, where coefficients are mapped from $F$ to $\Omega$. Then evaluation at the $n$ distinct roots of $P$ induces an $\Omega$-algebra isomorphism $R\cong\prod_{\rho\in\Omega,\,P(\rho)=0}\Omega$; the root set has exactly $n$ elements.
